```sql
SELECT 
    p.ID,
    COUNT(*) as abnormal_count
FROM main."Patient" p
JOIN main."Laboratory" l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l."Date" >= '1997-01-01' 
  AND l."Date" < '1998-01-01'
  AND l."GOT" >= 60
GROUP BY p.ID
```
